warnings: This is an Interactive Brokers Flex Query CSV with every column heading in quotes, which we cannot read yet. Re-export the query with quotes switched off, or export an Activity Statement instead.
Step 1: Log in to IBKR Client Portal and open Performance & Reports > Flex Queries.
Step 2: Edit your Trades Flex Query and in the delivery settings turn off the option to include quotes around fields (the exact wording may vary), keeping the format as CSV.
Step 3: Run the query again and upload the new CSV, or export an Activity Statement (CSV) from Performance & Reports > Statements.
